headline: Gədəbəy district features mountainous terrain and 16.2% forest cover.

tags.reason: The area offers high nature index (79) and mountain terrain with a mean elevation of 1936 metres.
The district has a forest cover of 16.2% and 44 parks (4.34 per 10,000 residents, median 3.89).

summary: Gədəbəy is a mountain district with a population of 101,400 and a low density of 82 residents per km². It has 81 schools (7.99 per 10,000 residents, median 4.14) and 14 hospitals (1.38 per 10,000 residents, median 0.75). The infrastructure index is low at 27 compared to the national median of 47, with paved roads covering only 0.5% of known surfaces. Listings data shows 2 samples with 100% deed share and 50% mortgage share.
strengths: Hospital accessibility is high with 1.38 hospitals per 10,000 residents (national median 0.75).
School provision stands at 7.99 per 10,000 residents (national median 4.14).
Park density reaches 4.34 per 10,000 residents (national median 3.89).
weaknesses: Paved road share is low at 0.5% of known surfaces (national median 4.35%).
Transport index is 53, supported by only 7 bus stops (0.69 per 10,000 residents, median 0.27) and no metro stations.
Surface unknown percentage for roads is high at 59%.
best_for: Nature and quiet seekers valuing mountain elevation and forest areas.
Buyers looking for established public facilities like schools and hospitals.
